about_the_game:
Bounce across cocoa swamps on endless marshmallows, ride in a submarine, and dance with a cow.  Help Merry Bear find her mascot neighbors (and maybe some chic furniture) in a delightful, hand-drawn world influenced by mid-century illustration and advertising.

Merry Bear has always dreamed of becoming a theme park mascot, so she moves to the base of Summit Park. When she arrives, however, the neighborhood of mascots is empty and the Summit Park cable car is broken. To solve her dilemma, Merry Bear must travel through themed lands filled with fruit punch waterfalls, figure out how to make espresso, explore the depths of a drive-in cinema, and navigate a giant freezer filled with TV dinners and skating penguins.

This demo contains the main (Orange Valley) and Mallow Marsh, the hot cocoa themed world of Marsha the cat.

Openly explore a hand-drawn world filled with heavily themed lands:

No fighting, just DANCE with every creature you meet.

Discover new furniture, plants, records, and outfits to fill out your new house

Solve platforming puzzles and discover new areas by:

-Learning How to Swim

-Becoming fireproof by getting wrapped like a burrito

-Getting sucked into a projector and becoming a beam of light

-Making a pile of popcorn, then jumping in!
